sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The basic age exchange is *Hány* *éves* *vagy*? followed by a number + éves *vagyok*.

This question-and-answer pair is a mirror image of itself: Hány éves vagy? and [number] éves vagyok share the exact same word order, just with hány swapped for an actual number. That symmetry is a gift — once you can ask the question, you already know most of how to answer it. Talking about someone else drops the verb entirely, the same zero-copula pattern from Unit 1 (Ő Anna, not Ő van Anna): Hány éves? and Harminc éves — no vagyok, no van, nothing to conjugate at all.
